meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上该技能后,Claude会用ast-grep工具按代码语法结构而非文本来搜索和改写代码,支持25种语言;能查找特定形状的函数、调用、类、导入,执行确定性代码改写(如替换日志调用),并运行YAML规则扫描。
howto.when: 当用户要求按代码结构查找或修改(如查找特定形状的函数、重写日志调用、移除类型断言)时触发;纯文本搜索场景则用grep。

say.text: 找出所有接收Request参数的函数
移除代码里所有as any断言

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses ast-grep to search and rewrite code by syntax structure rather than text, across 25 languages. It can find functions/calls/classes/imports of a given shape, apply deterministic codemods like replacing log calls, and run YAML rule scans.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for structure-based code search or modification (e.g., find functions of a shape, rewrite log calls, strip casts); for plain text searches, use grep instead.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter.
Strip every as any cast in the code.
